description:
SuperGravel/Hybrid - Dominate All Roads: This Cafe Century Carbon20 Disc Brake FlatBar Gravel Hybrid road bike can do it all. Endurance design means higher headtubes for a bit more upright and comfortable riding positions.

2026 FEATURES: Advanced Carbon Frame Design with DynamicAngle Chainstay. Dynamic AngleStay, Allows shorter chainstay for more precise handling and reduces eliminates chain strikes.

Comes with wide PANARACER GRAVELKING (Msrp $140/pair) tires for maximum speed on your commute, capable of using up to 700x50c* to dominate gravel roads. Laugh and float over rough roads, gravel, chipseal and revel in your powerful disc brakes through virtually all weather conditions.

Perfect for the sport to advanced level athlete wanting the pro level performance of a Carbon frame, coupled with the Gravel Specific Shimano 20 Speed shifting precision and pro handling of a Carbon fork and dealing with a budget.
